---
title: "Handle results"
description: "Respond to capture completion and retrieve the verification result from your backend."
---

After your customer captures their document, Bouncr processes the scan. Use SDK callbacks to update the page and the result API to drive your application’s decision.

## Show upload and processing progress

Render `Phase.SUBMITTING` as an upload state and `Phase.PROCESSING` as a processing state. Keep the customer on the same scan while work completes.

Two callbacks let you choose when to update your flow:

| Callback | When it runs | Common use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onCaptureComplete(scanId)` | All required captures have been accepted | Close the capture screen and show processing elsewhere |
| `onComplete(scanId)` | The scan’s processing finishes | Ask your backend for the next step |

For example, replace the quickstart’s completion handler with:

```javascript
onComplete(scanId) {
  window.location.assign('/onboarding/review');
}
```

Have your review route look up the scan associated with the signed-in customer and retrieve its result. The completion callback signals finished processing; the API response supplies the verification decision.

## Retrieve a result

Call this endpoint from your backend with `scans:results:read`:

```bash
curl "$BOUNCR_API_URL/v1/scans/$SCAN_ID/result" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BOUNCR_API_TOKEN"
```

| Response field | Use it to… |
| --- | --- |
| `scan_id` | Match the result to your application record |
| `complete` | Check whether processing has finished |
| `verification` | Read the decision, integrity, age, and expiration checks |
| `document` | Read authorized document details, such as the person’s name and date of birth |
| `dmv` | Read the DMV check status and available details |

If processing is still running, keep the customer in your processing state and check again with a bounded polling interval. A `402` response means result access requires a purchase; handle it through your account/billing workflow.

Detailed result fields depend on the checks enabled for your integration. Treat an absent check as unavailable. Fetching the scan later returns its latest authorized result.

Example response, showing selected fields:

```json
{
  "scan_id": "128000000000000001",
  "complete": true,
  "verification": {
    "decision": "DECISION_ACCEPT",
    "integrity": "INTEGRITY_REAL",
    "of_age": true,
    "not_expired": true
  },
  "document": {
    "given_name": "Alex",
    "surname": "Morgan",
    "date_of_birth": "1995-06-15",
    "issuing_country": "US"
  }
}
```

### Interpret the decision

| `verification.decision` | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `DECISION_ACCEPT` | Accepted by the configured checks |
| `DECISION_REJECT` | Rejected by the configured checks |
| `DECISION_VERIFY` | Requires further verification or review |
| `DECISION_ACCEPT_BY_AUTHORIZED_ACTOR` | Accepted through an authorized override |
| `DECISION_REJECT_BY_AUTHORIZED_ACTOR` | Rejected through an authorized override |
| `DECISION_UNSPECIFIED` | No decision available |

Your application determines how to handle review and authorized overrides. Evaluate `complete` before taking a final action.

### Interpret individual checks

`verification.integrity` is one of `INTEGRITY_REAL`, `INTEGRITY_VERIFIED_REAL`, `INTEGRITY_POSSIBLY_FAKE`, `INTEGRITY_FAKE`, `INTEGRITY_VERIFIED_FAKE`, or `INTEGRITY_UNSPECIFIED`. Use it alongside the overall decision.

`of_age: true` and `not_expired: true` indicate positive checks. In this response, `false` can also represent a check with no positive result available; it does not distinguish an unavailable check from a failed check. When `verification` is absent or the decision is unspecified, keep the scan in your pending/review flow.

## List previous scans

Use `scans:list` to retrieve scans available to your integration:

```bash
curl "$BOUNCR_API_URL/v1/scans" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BOUNCR_API_TOKEN"
```

The response is an array of records containing `id`, `venue_id`, and `created_at`. To load the next page, pass the final record’s ID as `before`:

```bash
curl "$BOUNCR_API_URL/v1/scans?before=$LAST_SCAN_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BOUNCR_API_TOKEN"
```

Use your backend to combine this list with individual scan results for an activity view or review screen.
